notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.32 Official Update
notes.content:
[p]LIMSCAPE Version 1.32 Official Update

・Added the ability for the Sound Player Actor to follow the player and to disable default ambient sounds, allowing for fully custom ambient audio.
・Warp Actors now support viewpoint adjustment, letting you lock the camera to the warp point’s direction upon arrival.
・Fixed an issue where stuttering occurred when starting to run.
・Added a feature to warp directly to cleared save points from the in-level pause menu.
・Resolved an issue where the level name was reset when downloading a level from a URL.
・Implemented measures against an issue where, in some environments, Sandbox Mode characters would automatically move in one direction.
・Added a confirmation prompt when pressing the shutdown button.[/p]

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.30 Official Release Update
notes.content:
[h2]This update (1.30) is the official release version of 1.29 Beta. The update notes include changes since version 1.28.[/h2][p]In this update, we’ve added a [b]DirectX 11 Compatibility Mode[/b] that allows gameplay even on PCs that do not support DX12.
In addition, the user level-sharing site [b]LIMSCAPERS[/b] has finally launched in beta! Uploading and downloading levels is now dramatically easier.[/p][p]🆕 [b]Main Updates[/b][/p][p]■ [b]Main Application (LIMSCAPE 1.30)[/b]
・Added DX11 fallback mode (lower quality, but playable on PCs without DX12 support)
・Fixed an issue where the key mapping menu could not be closed with ESC
・Added a button in the UI to directly connect to LIMSCAPERS
・Added support for automatically loading linked content from external URLs and files
・Added a LIMSCAPERS button to the "Create New" screen in SANDBOX MODE[/p][p]■ [b]Launcher[/b]
・Added the ability to load levels from LIMSCAPERS using a URL scheme
・Added support for opening .limscape files by double-clicking them
・Added a launch menu option for DirectX 11 compatibility mode
・Added registry registration for URL/file schemes and icons[/p][p]■ [b]LIMSCAPERS (External Sharing Site)[/b]
・Account registration with Email and Google login support
・Upload levels directly from the game
・Search, edit, and delete levels
・Comment function (can be enabled/disabled)
・Reporting system, status feature, and various counters
・Additional thumbnail settings
・Established EULA and Privacy Policy[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – LIMSCAPE 1.28
notes.content: [h2]🔧 Main Improvements & Feature Updates[/h2][p]・[b]Zoom functionality[/b] is now available even while moving ・[b]Ladder behavior[/b] has been further stabilized ・[b]Swing mount/dismount[/b] motion has been made smoother and more natural ・[b]Flashlight Actor[/b] has been added ・[b]Rope thickness[/b] is now adjustable for Swing and Pendulum Actors ・[b]Default walking speed[/b] increased by 10% (from 475 to 522) for more natural movement ・Fixed an issue where [b]running couldn’t be triggered by rapidly pressing Shift[/b] (obsolete lock removed) ・Improved [b]player stability when standing on fast-moving Physics objects[/b]: if the player stands on a Physics-enabled object and its velocity exceeds 200 (VectorLength), the player is now reset to the previous frame’s position ・[b]Sliders now automatically receive a "slider" tag[/b] when inserted ・[b]Removed the ability to climb ladders and swings while holding objects[/b] — players now drop held items before mounting ・A [b]"Construction" button[/b] has been added to Water Zone Actors, allowing manual refresh of water surface data ・[b]Launcher false-positive antivirus detections have been reduced[/b] by removing file polling and self-closing logic; now the launcher window is closed by Unreal Engine directly ・Fixed an issue where the [b]"Running Mode"[/b] would reset upon key input ・Fixed an issue where [b]diagonal movement[/b] was faster than intended (adjusted for cinematic consistency) ・Fixed an issue where only [b]horizontal movement in water[/b] was excessively fast ・In the Movement Settings, the label [b]“Foot step noise”[/b] has been renamed to [b]“Walking camera motion”[/b] for clarity ・Fixed an issue in Sandbox Mode where [b]Water Zone initialization could fail[/b] in lightweight levels ・[b]Zoom speed[/b] is now adjustable via settings ・Implemented [b]gamepad and keyboard key remapping[/b] functionality ・Fixed an issue where [b]Steam Achievements[/b] could be unlocked while in Edit Mode ・Improved the stability of the [b]Time Reversal Actor[/b]: autosaves during overlap are now disabled, and problematic rollback logic has been removed ・Actors can now have a [b]separate display name[/b], improving identification during selection and editing ・For Actor-internal selection, added a [b]“Reference” button[/b] for additionally selected objects ・Added a setting to adjust or disable [b]Depth of Field[/b] to address poor focus at high zoom levels[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧱 Level-Specific Fixes[/h2][p]・[b]Level 1[/b]: Fixed a gap in the room with aligned pillars where players could fall through ・[b]Level 1[/b]: Fixed an issue where exiting water near stairs and guardrails allowed players to escape the level boundaries ・[b]Level 2[/b]: Adjusted visuals to prevent the phone from visibly switching states ・[b]Level 4[/b]: Adjusted the gap where the small smile ball drops into a hole ・[b]Level 5[/b]: Fixed an issue where players could get knocked out at the end of the slider in the spinning disc room (placed knockout prevention actor)[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌐 Localization Updates[/h2][p]・[b]Overhauled all key mapping-related translations[/b] ・[b]Improved localization for Overlap-related Actor names[/b] in all non-English, non-Japanese languages ・[b]French[/b]: Corrected “Libraly” to “Librairie” ・[b]French[/b]: Corrected “S'il le fait” to “Si vous le faites” ・[b]French[/b]: Fixed verb agreement when using plural “elles” ・[b]French[/b]: Changed “Glissière” to the more accurate “Glissoire” ・[b]French[/b]: Replaced the uncommon “Maillage” with “Mesh”, and corrected “matériau” to the proper plural “matériaux” where necessary ・[b]Added translation for “Zoom Sensitivity”[/b][/p]

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Ver 1.27 Now Available on the Beta Branch

[h3]🔧 Patch Notes – LIMSCAPE 1.27

・Overhauled all key mapping related translations
・French: Corrected “Libraly” to “Librairie” (also fixed in other relevant languages)
・French: Corrected “S'il le fait” to “Si vous le faites”
・French: Fixed verb agreement when using plural “elles”
・French: Changed “Glissière” to the more accurate “Glissoire”
・French: Replaced the uncommon “Maillage” with “Mesh”, and corrected “matériau” to the proper plural “matériaux” where necessary

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
If no major issues arise, it is scheduled to be released to the Default branch within a few days.

✅ How to Access the Beta[/p][olist][*][p]Restart Steam (if it’s running in the background, right-click the Steam icon in the taskbar and choose "Exit")[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click [b]LIMSCAPE[/b] in your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Properties > Betas > Choose “beta”[/b] from the dropdown list[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: The liminal space exploration game LIMSCAPE has been released!
notes.content: [p]🎉 LIMSCAPE Officially Released Today 🎉The liminal space exploration game LIMSCAPE is now officially available on Steam.[/p][p]LIMSCAPE is a first-person exploration game where you walk, search, and feel your way through liminal spaces—quiet, nostalgic, and a little unsettling, yet somehow filled with a sense of something important you've almost forgotten.[/p][p]The game features five official stages:A hotel, a flood control facility, a metro station, a pool, and an office room.Each of these stages quietly tells its own story, expressing the themes and emotions woven into the world of LIMSCAPE.[/p][p]The game also includes a powerful sandbox mode that allows anyone to easily create their own 3D environments and bring unique liminal spaces to life.Looking ahead, we aim to release a system that enables players to share and publish their own stages, creating a space where “LIMSCAPERS” around the world can connect and create together.[/p][p]This game was developed entirely by one person, and it was only made possible through countless pieces of feedback and the incredible support of our community.Whether this is your first time playing or you’ve tried the demo before, I invite you to step into this one-of-a-kind world.[/p][p]I hope to see you in LIMSCAPE.[/p]

notes.title: LIMSCAPE FULL VERSION Launch — June 27 (Fri)
notes.content: [p]The wait is finally over — LIMSCAPE FULL VERSION will be released on June 27th (Fri)! With the full version, players can fully experience the world of LIMSCAPE, from mysterious exploration to creative sandbox building. Thank you for all your support throughout the development — and this is just the beginning. We hope you enjoy LIMSCAPE, create your own worlds, and share your adventures![/p]
